<function name="GetHDREnabled" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns whether HDR is currently enabled or not. This takes into account hardware support, current map and current client settings.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<added>2020.10.14</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">`true` if the player currently has HDR enabled.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
